title: FR: Change percentage of low battery indication/info
symptom: The user requests the ability to change the percentage at which the transmitter's battery charge indication turns red, currently at 25% (if remembered correctly), to a user-specified value like 10%.
evidence_quote: I mean that when it becomes 25% (if I remember correctly) of transmitter's battery charge, text is getting red. I'd wish to specify (for example) 10% to indicate (become red when it's) low battery charge.
